Effect of para-aryl-substituted N-phenyl groups on the photophysical 
properties of highly fluorescent dibenzo[c,g]carbazole-based 
chromophores

28644, Republic of Korea

Kangwon National University, Chuncheon, Gangwon 24341, Republic of Korea

Republic of Korea

Korea

Fig. S6. Cyclic voltammograms (CV) of (a) DBC-Ph, (b) DBC-Nap, (c) DBC-Ant, (d) DBC-Pyr, and 
(e) DBC-Cbz showing oxidation (1 mM in MeCN, scan rate = 100 mV/s for oxidation).
Fig. S7. CV of all compounds coated on 3 mm Pt disk in MeCN contained 100 mM of TBAPF6 as the 
supporting electrolyte. For sample preparation, 10 μL of a 1 mM solution in THF was drop-cast onto the 
Pt electrode. The scan rate was 100 mV/s.
Fig. S8. PL spectra of DBC-based compounds in (a) THF (10 μM) and (b) MeCN (10 μM) at 298 K.
